title: A Harbor registry answers unauthenticated
summary: The Harbor system info endpoint answers without a sign in, which reveals the registry and its configuration.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and (body_contains("harbor_version") or body_contains("registry_url")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Require authentication on Harbor and keep it off the public internet.
